genius.licensingRegulator: AMF authorizes the management company Twenty First Capital under GP-11000029; the professional specialized fund itself is not AMF-authorized
genius.notes: The issuing vehicle is an unincorporated French FCP co-ownership fund established on 24 July 2025 and managed by Twenty First Capital SAS; Spiko Finance acts as distributor and DLT technology provider, and this fund is separate from SPIKO SICAV. The prospectus states that the fund is a professional specialized fund not authorized by the AMF, that shares are reserved for professional clients under Article 423-27 of the AMF General Regulation, and that shares may not be offered or sold, directly or indirectly, on behalf of or for the benefit of a US Person as defined in Regulation S. Subscription and redemption occur at the daily net asset value, so there is no obligation to redeem for a fixed amount of monetary value. Management-company authorization does not establish a GENIUS payment stablecoin approval. Fund reporting and NAV publication are not stablecoin reserve attestations. The AMF Enforcement Committee decision of 20 December 2021 issued a warning and a 100,000 euro fine to Twenty First Capital over capital, traceability and conflict-of-interest procedures; this review located no U.S. action naming the fund, its manager or Spiko Finance.
